## Undergraduate courses (UFMS)

### Bioestatística — Ciências Biológicas

Disciplina obrigatória de 68 h ministrada anualmente no INBio/UFMS,
cobrindo estatística descritiva, delineamento amostral, distribuições
de probabilidade, inferência via teste de hipóteses e modelos lineares
(t, ANOVA, regressão, qui-quadrado).

[Course site & materials →](teaching/bioestatistica/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

### Urban Ecology — Ciências Biológicas

Disciplina optativa de 51 h para alunos de graduação em Ciências
Biológicas. Cobre biodiversidade urbana, fragmentação de hábitats,
ilha de calor, respostas ecossistêmicas, invasões biológicas,
desigualdade social e "luxury effect", ambientes aquáticos urbanos,
evolução contemporânea, e ciência cidadã (iNaturalist + R).
Ofertada em 2019/2 e 2022/2.

[Course site & materials →](teaching/ecologia-urbana/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Estatística Descomplicada — YouTube channel

::: {.callout-tip icon=false appearance="minimal"}
[{{< fa brands youtube >}} **youtube.com/@DiogoBProvete**](https://www.youtube.com/@DiogoBProvete) ·
*Statistics for the life sciences, in plain Portuguese.*
:::

I run a YouTube channel — **Estatística Descomplicada** — with lessons on
statistics aimed at biologists and other life-scientists. The content
mirrors what I teach in graduate and undergraduate courses at UFMS:
**Generalized Linear (Mixed) Models**, **multivariate methods**, study
design, and the reproducible-analysis workflow in R.

Topics covered include hypothesis testing, GLM/GLMM with appropriate error
families, ordinations (PCA, NMDS, RDA, CCA), classification, and how to
read statistical results in the ecological literature without getting lost
in the jargon. New videos are released as the academic semester progresses.

[Subscribe to the channel →](https://www.youtube.com/@DiogoBProvete?sub_confirmation=1){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Graduate courses (UFMS)

### Introduction to R

Intensive graduate course (30 h, one-week format) for the [PPG in
Ecology & Conservation](https://ppgec.ufms.br/) at UFMS. Covers R from
scratch: syntax, RStudio, data import, `tidyverse` (`dplyr`, `tidyr`,
`purrr`, `broom`), data visualization with `ggplot2`, simple linear
models, basic programming, version control with `git`/GitHub, and
reproducible reports with R Markdown / Quarto. Designed for students
arriving at R for the first time.

[Course site & materials →](teaching/intro-r/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

### History and Philosophy of Science

Seminar-style graduate course (45 h) for the [PPG in Ecology &
Conservation](https://ppgec.ufms.br/) at UFMS. Open to graduate
students from any line of research. Covers the structure of
scientific theories, induction vs deduction, Popper's
falsifiability, Kuhn's revolutions, Lakatos's research programmes,
the nature of causality and explanation, holism vs reductionism in
biology, and how science differs from pseudoscience. Reading-based
discussion sessions led by student pairs.

[Course site & materials →](teaching/hfc/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

### Multidimensional analyses

Graduate course (45 h) for the [Mestrado em Biologia
Animal](https://ppgba.ufms.br) at UFMS, Campo Grande. Covers
classification (hierarchical and k-means clustering, IndVal),
unconstrained ordination (PCA, PCoA, nMDS, CA), constrained ordination
(CCA, RDA, db-RDA, LDA), Mantel/Procrustes/PROTEST, and PERMANOVA —
all hands-on in R with the `vegan`, `ade4` and `labdsv` packages.

[Course site & materials →](teaching/multidimensionais/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

### Phylogenetic comparative methods

Graduate course (45 h) for the [Mestrado em Biologia
Animal](https://ppgba.ufms.br) at UFMS, Campo Grande. Covers Brownian
motion, PGLS, ancestral state reconstruction, phylogenetic signal,
multi-regime OU models, and multivariate extensions — all hands-on in
R. Open to graduate students from any line of research with basic
familiarity with phylogenetic inference.

[Course site & materials →](teaching/mfc/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
[Mind map summarising the methods →](https://coggle.it/diagram/WhbkkxE2BAAB0R0m){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Past courses & short-courses

### 2012 — Mendeley demo, Universidade Federal de Goiás

[Slides with screenshots and tutorials](http://www.slideshare.net/provete/mendeley-presentation)

### 2011 — Ecological statistics with R

*Tópicos em Biologia Animal — Estatística aplicada à ecologia usando o R.*
A two-week graduate course in Animal Biology at
[UNESP](http://www.ibilce.unesp.br/) (São Paulo State University), in
collaboration with [Thiago
Gonçalves-Souza](http://thiagocalvesouza.wixsite.com/ecoffun) and
[Fernando R. Silva](http://fernandoecologia.wixsite.com/fernandorodrigues).
We covered Generalized Linear Models, the main multivariate methods, and
other ecological tools, using R as the analysis platform.

- [Class slides](https://www.sugarsync.com/pf/D9712667_69058108_487278)
- [Course book (CRAN-hosted)](http://cran.r-project.org/doc/contrib/Provete-Estatistica_aplicada.pdf)
- [Datasets for exercises](https://diogoprovete.weebly.com/uploads/1/7/3/6/17367099/data.zip)
- [R scripts](https://diogoprovete.weebly.com/uploads/1/7/3/6/17367099/script_completo_apostila_estatistica_aplicada_a_ecologia_usando_o_r.r)

### 2009 — Sampling techniques for vertebrates (PT)

Short course (4 h) for undergraduates at UNESP, given as a pre-meeting
course at the *4º Simpósio de Biologia Animal*. Ricardo Brassaloti and I
covered field sampling techniques for the four classes of vertebrates.

[Class slides](http://slidesha.re/eiu9Fx)
